items.evidence: horizon-client/src/game/machines.rs:941 hoppers_catch_items tests the narrow INSIDE bowl (0.125..0.875, 11/16..1) while vanilla 26.2 HopperBlockEntity.entityInside uses getSuckAabb() = Block.column(16,11,32) -> (0, 11/16, 0)-(1, 2, 1) (server-game.jar). Tick path covers the full AABB, so pickup is at most 1-2 ticks late, never missed. Unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.name: Hopper entity-catch uses the narrow bowl, not the full SUCK_AABB

items.evidence: crafter_eject (horizon-client/src/game/machines/crafter.rs:144) consults only the block-only Containers::view (machines.rs:213, returns None without a block entity), while vanilla 26.2 dispense uses HopperBlockEntity.getContainerAt (block container, else getEntityContainer). Hopper/dropper have the entity_container_at fallback (machines.rs:1274); the crafter lacks it. Result drops as an item instead. Unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.name: Crafter never ejects into container entities

items.evidence: crafter_eject trigger block (machines/crafter.rs:180-205) checks only self.player against the 17-box; vanilla 26.2 CrafterBlock.dispenseItem triggers ALL ServerPlayers in AABB.ofSize(center, 17, 17, 17) (server-game.jar). Geometry (8.5 half-extent strict intersects) matches for the host; LAN guests in range miss the trigger. Unchanged from 1.21.7.
items.name: Crafter recipe_crafted trigger fires only for the host player (LAN)

items.evidence: open_ender_chest (horizon-client/src/game/storage.rs:157-163) swaps the HOST's ender_items into the shared block BE; close (storage.rs:217) copies back and leaves an empty Chest(27). A LAN guest sees the host's items (while the host has it open) or an empty chest, never their own EnderItems. Single-player correct. storage.rs has 0 changed lines vs 1.21.7.
items.name: Ender chest shows the wrong inventory to LAN guests

items.evidence: BlockEntity::for_block returns None for minecraft:decorated_pot (no branch in containers.rs:376-516, no container_size entry at containers.rs:320-332), but vanilla 26.2 HAS the minecraft:decorated_pot BE type (DecoratedPotBlockEntity implements ContainerSingleItem$BlockContainerSingleItem, 1-slot container). Hopper insert/extract, dropper insert and comparator reads fail; chunk saves carry no pot BEs (port keeps pot item+sherds in a spill tag). Manual insert via use_decorated_pot works. In test_pot_hopper's scope (still a gap).
items.name: Hoppers/droppers cannot see decorated pots; port has no pot block entity

systemic_note: The 1.21.7 systemic cause (26.x component/tag logic carried into a version that lacks those lookups) is inverted for 26.2: the 26.2 port was written against 26.2's own forms and all three 1.21.7 MAJOR defects are fixed (furnaces light from the FuelValues table, brewing brews from the #brewing_fuel tag, cartography zooms with no tag gate). Six more 1.21.7 defects are withdrawn because vanilla itself changed between 1.21.7 and 26.2. The five remaining defects are one-off logic divergences carried over unchanged. Oracle breakage is far lighter than 1.21.7's: 16 of 26 oracles now pass; the 10 remaining failures are 1-7 errors each, dominated by two one-error repairs (MenuOracle blocking 4 drivers, DispenserOracle blocking 6 sweep-wide).
